As Animal Sight, except any being may be used

As Animal Sense I, except the range is 300'
As Sight Merge I, except the range is 300'
As Animal Sight I, except the range is 500'
As Sight Merge I, except all of the being's senses can be used
As Animal Sense I, except the range is 500'
As Sight Merge I, except the range is 500'
As Animal Sense I, except the range is 1 mile/lvl
